_source: Five Parsecs: Tactics p.163 (Keltrin (Skulkers) profiles and Special Rules). Units are composed from data/tactics/army_builder.json (pp.133-139); weapons come from data/tactics/tactics_weapons_master.json (p.181)

species.description: Stealthy ambush predators. Skulkers are difficult to detect and excel at striking from concealment.

traits.name: Agile
traits.description: Skulkers do not suffer movement penalties when moving in Difficult terrain or Area terrain features, and reduce all other movement cost reductions (such as doors, Linear obstacles, and so forth) by 1".

traits.name: Resilient
traits.description: Skulkers receive a 3+ Saving Throw against any kind of toxin, virus, or gas.
